newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila Central Bank net buyer of dlrs on Friday.
newsitem.headline: Manila Central Bank net buyer of dlrs on Friday.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank said it was a net buyer of dollars in the foreign exchange market on Friday.
"As of today, we're a net buyer," Central Bank governor Gabriel Singson told reporters. He did not disclose the amount of dollars the Bank had bought so far.
The peso has been hit in recent days due to fears of large outflows from stock market sales.
The Central Bank sold over $120 million on Wednesday, traders said.
Early on Friday, the Central Bank was still selling dollars at 26.375 pesos to satisfy demand from foreign funds after banks were closed for a holiday on Thursday, traders said.
Banks later sold dollars to the Central Bank after testing its resolve to limit the peso's fall at 26.375.
Aside from flooding the market with dollars, the Central Bank also raised its overnight borrowing rate by 0.75 percentage-point to 11 percent late Wednesday to quell peso speculation.
